This is the page you will value most in 2029, and it is worth more than the dossier because it is the only part of the year that cannot be reconstructed later.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- List what you believed at the start that turned out to be wrong, with what changed your mind in each case.
- Name what took three times longer than planned and which milestone you would drop.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>65 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [30 min]{.task-min} Write the wrong beliefs with their corrections: the marks you made last night, each with the evidence that moved you and the date it did. Expect several to be about how much of a backtested result survives contact with costs, and at least one to be about how long something would take.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Write the process retrospective: what took three times longer than planned, which milestone you would drop, what you would add, and how you would spend the next 365 hours differently. Be specific about the hours; a plan without a time budget is the same mistake this course was designed around.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [10 min]{.task-min} Add the one about yourself: the class of error you made most often, which is more useful than any individual mistake because it predicts the next one.
:::
:::

## Checkpoint

:::
